message.content:
You are fixing two final-review findings in the `/api/trades/*` route block in `server/routes.ts` (TaptPay app, repo /home/runner/workspace, branch `feat/trades-vertical`). The trades block is the most recent trades routes (roughly lines 6505–6790; all paths start with `/api/trades/`). Edit ONLY that trades block in `server/routes.ts`. Do not touch property routes or any other file.

## Fix A (Important) — wrap every trades handler in try/catch matching the property pattern
Currently every `/api/trades/*` route handler is a bare `async (req, res) => { ... }` with no error handling, so a thrown error (e.g. a storage/DB failure) escapes as an unhandled rejection. EVERY property route in this file wraps its body in try/catch. Make the trades handlers consistent.

First READ an existing property handler to copy its EXACT catch shape — look at `app.post("/api/property/invoices"` (~line 6026) and `app.post("/api/property/invoices/:id/mark-paid-external"` (~line 6104). Mirror whatever that catch block does (typically: `catch (err) { if (err instanceof z.ZodError) return res.status(400).json(...); console.error("<context>", err); return res.status(500).json({ message: "..." }); }` — but use the ACTUAL shape you find in this file so it's consistent).

For EACH trades route handler (clients GET/POST/GET:id/PUT/archive/events; quotes GET/POST/GET:id; the public token respond; invoices GET/POST/send-balance/mark-paid-external/complete/void; schedules GET/POST/PUT/DELETE):
- Wrap the existing body in `try { <existing body> } catch (err) { <property-style catch> }`.
- Keep all existing logic byte-for-byte inside the try; only add the wrapper and indentation.
- Preserve the existing `.safeParse` 400 returns as-is (they stay inside the try).
- Use a short context string in each console.error (e.g. the route path) so logs are traceable, matching how property routes label theirs.

## Fix B (cosmetic) — align the public /respond Zod error message
In `POST /api/trades/quotes/token/:token/respond`, the `acceptQuoteSchema.safeParse` failure currently returns `res.status(400).json({ message: "Invalid" })`. Change it to `res.status(400).json({ message: parsed.error.errors[0].message })` to match the rest of the trades routes (use the actual safeParse result variable name in that handler).

## Verify + commit
1. `npm run check` — confirm NO new TypeScript errors from your edits (the repo has ~42 PRE-EXISTING errors unrelated to trades — confirm your changes add none in the trades block; the repo has no DB integration-test harness, so typecheck is the covering check).
2. Commit ONLY `server/routes.ts`:
```
git add server/routes.ts
git commit -m "fix(trades): wrap route handlers in try/catch, align /respond zod error

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
```
Do NOT run git stash/switch/checkout.

## Report
Include in your final message (under 12 lines): Status (DONE|BLOCKED|NEEDS_CONTEXT); commit SHA+subject; one-line `npm run check` result; how many handlers you wrapped; confirmation Fix B applied; the exact catch shape you mirrored (one line); any concern. If /tmp is writable also append details to /tmp/sdd/task-3-report.md, but the inline summary is what matters.
